description: Brown and Company PLC v. The Minister of Labour and Others Brown and Company PLC v. The Minister of Labour and Others View More before S. Srikandarajah, J.

keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash the arbitral award granted in favour of eight of the Petitioner’s employees who were allegedly wrongfully terminated. Held - the Petitioner’s Application is allowed subject to the limitation of compensation granted to the said employees.
